item.title: 福岡で酷暑日、熊本・八代も史上最高 年間の40度以上日数が最多に www.asahi.com/articles/ASV.…
item.author: 朝日新聞 (@asahi.com)
item.description:
福岡で酷暑日、熊本・八代も史上最高　年間の40度以上日数が最多に
www.asahi.com/articles/ASV...

熊本地震で大きな被害を受けた熊本県八代市でも39.2度で、2日連続で観測史上最高を記録した。

気象庁によると、2026年に40度以上を観測した日数は10日となった。25年の9日を抜いて、年間の日数が観測史上最多となった。

item.title: Dolly Parton did all the good she could, for all the people …
item.author: Hillary Rodham Clinton (@hillaryclinton.bsky.social)
item.description:
Dolly Parton did all the good she could, for all the people she could, for as long as ever she could.

From her legendary songwriting to the Imagination Library—which sent 1 million books a month to children across the country—she was the best of America.

Dolly, we'll miss your great heart.

item.title: We’re going to hear about how everyone loved Dolly, and that…
item.author: Ross Johnson (@rosserford.bsky.social)
item.description: We’re going to hear about how everyone loved Dolly, and that feels true. But it’s good to remember, and to her credit, that she was attacked for her AIDS activism, her vaccine advocacy, her LGBTQ+ support and even, more recently, for her reading initiatives. She ALWAYS stood firm when it mattered.
